evidence_limits: Source hashes identify inspected checkout files, not an attestation that the running process loaded those exact compiled bytes.
Bundle search was skipped by find's documented 2 MiB content-size limit; no shell content-read workaround was used.
Two command input validations rejected virtual-looking path literals before execution; corrected native/relative arguments succeeded without changing permissions.
Daemon MCP handshake and browser enabled do not prove current account model availability or a current live agent page.
A ready result with an old timestamp does not establish that the page is closed; it fails to establish current liveness.
All performance numbers describe read-only diagnostics on the Mac, not model latency or swarm throughput.
The raw daemon status includes private endpoint URLs; only a whitelist projection was retained. No tokens, endpoint secrets, conversation IDs or unrelated goals are stored.
